cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings creates a Draft meeting with its roster and history.

expected: HTTP 201 Created with header Location: /api/meetings/<id>.

Body: { "code": "MSG29", "message": "Tạo cuộc họp thành công.", "meeting": { ... } } where "meeting" has "status": "Draft", the submitted title, schedule, "mode": "Hybrid", "sensitivity": "Internal", "createdById" = the Organizer, "actualStartedAt": null, "actualEndedAt": null, "chair": { "userId", "fullName" } and "secretaries": [ ... ] from the roster.

No notification is sent to the roster while the meeting is a Draft.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.
Active Chair and Secretary accounts exist (their user ids are known to the tester).

procedure: Sign in as an administrator (AdminUsers) and keep the access token.
Body: { "action": "TransferOrganizer", "organizerId": "<id of a Member without MeetingCreator>" }
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request: { "code": "MSG134", "message": "Người tổ chức mới không hợp lệ hoặc không còn quyền tạo cuộc họp." }.
No history row is written.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Approved meeting whose Organizer is deactivated; administrator account.

cases.description: Verify TransferOrganizer is refused while the current Organizer is active or the meeting is not Approved.
procedure: Sign in as an administrator (AdminUsers) and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict: { "code": "MSG135", "message": "Trạng thái cuộc họp đã thay đổi hoặc không cho phép thao tác này." }.
A repeat after a successful transfer answers the same.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Approved meeting whose Organizer is still active; administrator account.

cases.description: Verify TransferOrganizer answers 404 to an account that is not an administrator.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer or a Member and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 404 Not Found with an empty body: the meeting is not revealed.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Approved meeting whose Organizer is deactivated.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions rejects an unknown, numeric or composite action.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer and keep the access token.
expected: Every request answers HTTP 400 Bad Request: { "code": "MSG80", "message": "Yêu cầu chuyển trạng thái không hợp lệ." }.
Nothing is written and no status changes.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Meeting created by the Organizer.
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions rejects fields that do not belong to the action.
procedure: Sign in as the assigned Approver and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, code "MSG80": the client cannot send an actor, status or timestamp and an action takes only its own fields.
The meeting stays WaitingApproval.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Meeting WaitingApproval assigned to an Approver.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions requires JSON and a body under 64 KiB.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send it with a JSON body larger than 64 KiB.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type, code "MSG34".
Step 3: HTTP 413 Payload Too Large, code "MSG87".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Meeting created by the Organizer.
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions requires a token and hides meetings the caller cannot read.
procedure: Send POST /api/meetings/<id>/transitions with { "action": "Publish" } and no Authorization header.
Sign in as an unrelated account and send the same request.
Send it for an unknown meeting id.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Steps 2 and 3: HTTP 404 Not Found with an empty body, indistinguishable from each other.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Existing Approved meeting; an unrelated active account.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions answers 503 MSG131 when the account cannot be checked.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Make the account lookup fail, then send POST /api/meetings/<id>/transitions with { "action": "Publish" }.
expected: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable: { "code": "MSG131", "message": "Không thể kiểm tra tài khoản để thực hiện thao tác cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại." }.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
QA lead can make the account lookup fail.
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history gives the Organizer the full timeline in order.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 200 OK: { "items": [ ... ], "page": 1, "pageSize": 20, "totalCount": <n>, "totalPages": <n> } ordered by "occurredAt" then "id" ascending.

Each item has "id", "meetingId", "action", "fromStatus", "resultingStatus", "actorId", "actorName", "occurredAt", "rejectionReason", "assignedApproverId" (on SubmitForApproval) and, on Cancel, "cancellationReason".
A rejected meeting shows the "rejectionReason" to the Organizer.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.
Meeting that was created, submitted and rejected.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history gives the current approver the full timeline.
procedure: Sign in as the assigned Approver.
expected: HTTP 200 OK with the full timeline including the rejection reasons of earlier cycles.
A former approver (no longer assigned) who is not on the roster gets HTTP 404.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Meeting WaitingApproval assigned to an Approver.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history redacts the rejection reason for a Member.
procedure: Sign in as a Member on the roster of the Published meeting.
expected: HTTP 200 OK; every item has "rejectionReason": null and "previousOrganizerId"/"newOrganizerId": null.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Published meeting that was rejected once before publication; Member on its roster.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history lets the Chair read before Publish.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair of a Draft meeting.
expected: HTTP 200 OK with the timeline and the rejection reason; organizer-transfer fields stay null.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Draft meeting that was rejected, then returned to Draft, with a Chair on its roster.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history pages and answers empty past the end.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
expected: Step 2: at most 2 items, "totalPages" matches "totalCount".
Step 3: HTTP 200 OK with "items": [].
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.
Meeting with at least 3 history rows.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history rejects invalid paging.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
expected: Both answer HTTP 400 Bad Request: { "code": "MSG86", "message": "Tham số truy vấn không hợp lệ." }.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history requires a token and hides meetings the caller cannot read.
procedure: Sign in as an unrelated account and send it again.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Step 2: HTTP 404 Not Found with an empty body.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Existing meeting; an unrelated account.
